mentions.name: USM.tools
mentions.description: A tool for specifying services in a structured way, using markdown to capture the semi-structured middle ground between unstructured and structured data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on USM.tools, which allows specifying your services in structured way.

There is a need to specify some of the data in semi-structured way, and I am using markdown for that.
